sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:43

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:43:1
items.html:
His body was from the world of Yetzira; his Nefesh from the world of Beria; his Ruach from the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut; his Neshama from the ZA of Atzilut; and his Neshama of Neshama from Aba and Ima of Atzilut. Here we need extra contemplation in order to reconcile this short discourse with the broad discourse brought after it, and likewise with the other discourses brought on this matter. One should know that before the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, Adam had two discernments of NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama]: for he had NRN from BYA, and also NRN from Atzilut. He also had an external garment over them, similar to the corporeal body of now, of which it is said, “And the Lord God formed man of dust from the ground,” etc. And it is brought below that all the worlds were at a higher degree than they are now, for from the Chazeh [chest] of Yetzira of now downward was the dwelling of the shells. ZA of Atzilut was in the place of Aba, and the Nukva in the place of Ima; Beria was in the place of ZA of Atzilut; the GAR [first three] of Yetzira in the place of the Nukva of Atzilut; the six lower ones of Yetzira in the place of the first six of Beria of now; the GAR of Assiya in the place of the four lower ones of Beria of now; and the six lower ones of Assiya in the place of the six upper ones of Yetzira of now. For the Sium [end] of the legs was at the place of the Chazeh of Yetzira of now; see below, item 55, the entire continuation.
And behold, the external garment of Adam HaRishon was made of Malchut of Assiya, which is called “dust from the ground”; however, the place of the Temple was created from the Beria of this Malchut. But the whole of Assiya was then above the Chazeh of Yetzira of now, as above. After that, he had NRN from BYA: Nefesh and Ruach he had from Assiya and Yetzira, and they are also called the discernment of the body of Adam HaRishon, for the VAK [six ends] are called a body, as is known; and Neshama he had from Beria. And after that, he had NRN from Atzilut: Nefesh from the Nukva of Atzilut, who was clothed in the world of Yetzira, as above, and because of the clothing of the Nukva in the world of Yetzira, which is the discernment of ZA, this Nefesh is therefore regarded by the name Ruach. And Ruach he had from ZA of Atzilut, who is clothed in the world of Beria, and because of the clothing of ZA in Beria, which is the discernment of Neshama and YESHSUT, as is known, this Ruach is therefore regarded by the name Neshama. And Neshama of Neshama he had from ZON of Atzilut, who were then in the place of Aba and Ima.
And this is what he says, “His body was from the world of Yetzira”: that is, the discernment of his Nefesh and Ruach, which are called VAK or a body — both of them were from the world of Yetzira, for the Assiya of that time stood above the Chazeh of Yetzira; and because of this it is regarded that his Nefesh too, which he received from Assiya, is also the discernment of Yetzira relative to now.
And this is what he says, “his Nefesh from the world of Beria”: that is, the discernment of Neshama he had from the world of Beria, and it is called by the name Nefesh relative to the Nefesh of Atzilut. And this is what he says, “his Ruach from the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut”: that is, from the part of the Nukva that was then clothed in the GAR of Yetzira, as above; and it is called by the name Ruach because of the clothing in the world of Yetzira, which is the discernment of ZA and of Ruach. And this is what he says, “his Neshama from the ZA of Atzilut”: that is, from the part of ZA that is clothed in the world of Beria, as above; and it is called Neshama — although all that comes from ZA is only Ruach — because of its clothing in Beria, which is the discernment of Neshama and the discernment of YESHSUT. And this is what he says, “and Neshama of Neshama from Aba and Ima”: that is, from ZON, who rose and clothed AVI, for ZA then rose to the place of Aba, and the Nukva rose to the place of Ima, as above.
